proposal.label: needs reproducible example
proposal.comment: Could you provide a small, shareable reproducer that registers the described table function (showing the C++ registration code) with `varargs = LogicalType::ANY`, plus the exact SQL you run that fails and the complete error message? A minimal reproducer that we can compile/run or an equivalent SQL-test demonstrating the rejection will make it possible to validate and apply the suggested change.
proposal.rationale: The report explains the intended behavior and shows an example call, but lacks a complete, reproduceable function registration and runnable test case. Without a minimal reproducer (registration code and the exact failing SQL/error), the failure cannot be followed or validated.
